fact: The party discovered the remains of a drow, a dark metal mace, and scattered coins suspended inside a gelatinous cube.
source_quote: the party discovered the remains of a drow, a dark metal mace, and scattered coins apparently hovering above the floor. The objects were suspended inside a gelatinous cube
subject: dungeon corridor

fact: The gelatinous cube has two visible eyes.
source_quote: suspended inside a gelatinous cube with two visible eyes
subject: gelatinous cube

fact: The gelatinous cube is sentient.
source_quote: Now, inexplicably, he could think and see.
subject: gelatinous cube

fact: Glabbagool is the name of the sentient gelatinous cube.
source_quote: He introduced himself as Glabbagool
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool was previously an average gelatinous cube that cleaned floors and decomposed debris.
source_quote: until recently he had been “an average garden variety gelatinous cube,” moving around, cleaning floors, and decomposing whatever adventurers left behind
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool recently gained the ability to think and see.
source_quote: Now, inexplicably, he could think and see.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool is fascinated by the implications of his new sentience.
source_quote: Glabbagool was fascinated by the implications of sentience.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool admits he knows little about the world.
source_quote: readily admitted that he knew little about the world
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool does not know which route leads upward.
source_quote: He also had no idea which route led upward
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool spent much of his brief sentient life standing in place deciding where to go.
source_quote: having spent much of his brief sentient life standing in place and deciding where to go
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool was surprised to learn that sentient beings differ in intelligence and awareness.
source_quote: I thought everybody was sentient in the same way.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool claims he would never want to promote the party's demise.
source_quote: Glabbagool insists he would never want to promote their demise.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool is especially excited about talking to Thorin.
source_quote: becomes especially excited about talking to his new friend Thorin
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool is aware of the rising water and considers it awkward but has no suggestions to avoid it.
source_quote: Glabbagool has noticed the rising water and considers it awkward, but he has no suggestion for avoiding it.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: The drow corpse suspended inside Glabbagool is nearly digested.
source_quote: The drow suspended inside him is nearly digested.
subject: drow corpse

fact: A dark metal mace is suspended inside Glabbagool.
source_quote: the remains of a drow, a dark metal mace, and scattered coins apparently hovering above the floor
subject: dark metal mace

fact: Scattered coins are suspended inside Glabbagool.
source_quote: the remains of a drow, a dark metal mace, and scattered coins apparently hovering above the floor
subject: scattered coins

fact: Gyrgum tossed a lucky foot to Glabbagool.
source_quote: Gyrgum tossed Glabbagool a lucky foot that he had been carrying in his backpack.
subject: lucky foot

fact: The party is uncertain what creature the lucky foot came from.
source_quote: The party admits uncertainty over what creature the foot originally came from.
subject: lucky foot

fact: Thorin entered the area while actively searching for oozes and probing suspicious pools.
source_quote: Thorin enters while actively searching for more oozes and probing suspicious pools.
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin introduced himself to the gelatinous cube.
source_quote: Thorin introduces himself, and the creature replies, “My name is Glabbagool.”
subject: Thorin

fact: Glabbagool accepted Thorin's invitation to join the expedition.
source_quote: Glabbagool accepted, though he politely asked, “You won’t be upset if you all die and I eat you, right?”
subject: Glabbagool joins party

fact: The party agreed that Glabbagool can eat them if they die of natural causes.
source_quote: The party agreed that once they were dead they would probably be past caring, provided Glabbagool allowed natural causes to do the killing.
subject: cannibalism agreement

fact: Glabbagool absorbed the lucky foot and found it tasty.
source_quote: The cube absorbed it and declared it tasty.
subject: lucky foot absorbed

fact: Glabbagool offered to eat any unwanted objects the party drops on the floor.
source_quote: Glabbagool also offered a standing service to the party: “If you ever decide you want to get rid of something, just drop it on the floor and I’ll be happy to eat it.”
subject: waste disposal service

fact: The party decided not to feed Glabbagool ghost bones because the associated ghost would react angrily.
source_quote: The party decides against feeding him the ghost bones because the associated ghost reacts angrily.
subject: ghost bones rejection
